root.label: AP-NORC September 2026 poll on voters and political parties

events.label: AP-NORC September 2026 poll on voters and political parties

slots.name: wealthy focus rating
slots.sentence: The survey finds that about 6 in 10 registered voters say the phrase “focused on helping rich and powerful people” describes the Republican Party “extremely” or “very” well.

slots.name: problem confidence rating
slots.sentence: Only about 2 in 10 registered voters say that “able to solve important problems” or “focused on helping people like me” describes the Democratic Party “extremely” or “very” well.

slots.name: extreme party rating
slots.sentence: Meanwhile, 55% of registered voters say the Republican Party is “too extreme.” Some 45% say the same about the Democratic Party.

slots.name: shutdown count
slots.sentence: In the last year alone, the federal government partially shut down twice for weeks because of partisan disputes in Congress over spending on healthcare and immigration enforcement.

slots.name: poll sample size
slots.sentence: The AP-NORC poll of 2,140 adults, including 1,766 registered voters, was conducted Sept. 24-28 using a sample drawn from NORC’s probability-based AmeriSpeak Panel, which is designed to be representative of the U.S. population.
